# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Prototype Horde

This file is intentionally a thin pointer to avoid drift between two
near-identical docs. The single source of truth for working style,
code standards, and AI workflow is [`../CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md).

Copilot: read `CLAUDE.md` and follow it as written. The other
top-level docs it references are also authoritative:

- [`../README.md`](../README.md) — public description of the project.
- [`../PLAN.md`](../PLAN.md) — phases, tasks, current status.
- [`../REFERENCES.md`](../REFERENCES.md) — books, articles, and code to consult.
- [`../RAYLIB_STANDARD.md`](../RAYLIB_STANDARD.md) — code style matching raylib.
- [`../BLUEPRINT.md`](../BLUEPRINT.md) — how to start a new project from `lib/`.
- [`../docs/modules/`](../docs/modules/) — per-module reference.

Two notes specific to Copilot:

- Chat with the user is in Spanish; documentation and code in English.
- Copilot must not branch, commit, or push unless explicitly asked
  (`commit esto`, `pusheá`, `creá una branch para X`).
